mentions.name: WordPecker
mentions.description: A personalized vocabulary and language-learning app that works like a Duolingo for words you actually encounter, with an open-source version, a mobile app, and an alpha currently in bug-fixing and feature testing. The end goal is an AI language learning companion that knows what you read, listen to, and watch and builds a personalized path to take you from B1 to B2, C1, and beyond using that context.
mentions.problem: Generic vocabulary learning isn't tied to the words learners actually encounter; the project started from struggling to read books in English.
mentions.audience: Language learners who want vocabulary practice based on material they actually read and consume
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on WordPecker, trying to create something like a personalized Duolingo but for vocabulary you actually encounter.
